name: Kim Eung-soo
bio: Kim Eung-soo was born on February 12, 1961 in South Korea. He is an actor, known forKo-ri-a (2012), Annyeong UFO (2004) and Wi-heom-han Sang-gyeon-rye (2011).

credits.title: Bedford Park
credits.overview: Haunted by an abusive childhood, Audrey, a Korean American woman in her 30s, faces her emotional past. When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, she meets the man responsible for the accident. Their relationship builds, passions ignite, and they form a loving connection.

credits.title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince
credits.overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.

credits.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
credits.overview: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. credits.title: Ransomed
credits.overview: In Beirut 1986, during the Lebanese civil war a Korean diplomat is taken hostage without a trace. Two years pass and long forgotten, a young diplomat Min-jun receives a phone call proving that the hostage is still alive. With the given mission, Min-jun is sent to Beirut to save the hostage with a bag of ransom money.

credits.title: Swallow
credits.overview: When his mother goes missing, Lee Ho-yeon sets out to search for her. In the course of that journey, he discovers his parents' pasts during the democracy protests of the 1980s when student activists rose up against the repressive Chun Doo-hwan regime. credits.title: A Different Girl
credits.overview: Tells the story of unpredictable events that take place in the close relationship between a perfectionist Wan Jun, his girlfriend Ji Yeon, and Ye Ri, who has a crush on Wan Jun .

credits.title: Dino King: Journey to Fire Mountain
credits.overview: Speckles, a ferocious tarbosaurus and his young son junior, mourning the loss of their family in an epic battle, roam the lands in search of food, adventure and peace. credits.title: By Quantum Physics: A Nightlife Venture
credits.overview: An advocate of the concept ‘thoughts create reality’, Chan-woo endeavors to realize his dream of running a high-end nightclub when he finds himself caught in the center of a power game in the criminal underworld.

credits.title: The Spy Gone North
credits.overview: South Korea, 1993. An agent of the National Intelligence Service is sent to Beijing to infiltrate a group of North Korean officials with the ultimate goal of obtaining information about their nuclear program.

credits.title: Yongsoon
credits.overview: Yong-soon is an 18-year-old high school student. She falls in love with her gym teacher, but she thinks her teacher might have a girlfriend. Yong-Soon and her friends try to find out whether he does have a girlfriend, but they can't find any clues. Making things worse, her father brings a new stepmother from Mongolia.

credits.title: The King's Case Note
credits.overview: A clever king of Joseon and his brilliant chronicler hunt for the truth behind a crime that threatens the throne and the stability of the country.

credits.title: Run-Off
credits.overview: In 2003 the year of Aomori Asian Games, Dae-woong, a former ice hockey player receives an offer to be a director of Korean national ice hockey team. credits.title: A Violent Prosecutor
credits.overview: After a prosecution lawyer is framed and convicted for murder, he tries to catch the real murderer from jail with the help of a con artist.

credits.title: The Vampire Lives Next Door to Us
credits.overview: A vampire living in a morgue encounters a drowned girl whose fate may be entwined with his own.

credits.title: Intimate Enemies
credits.overview: Four strangers discover a bag full of money which belongs to a corrupt politician. Instead of using the money for themselves, they decide to join forces to take down corrupt conglomerates.

credits.title: Enemies In-Law
credits.overview: Chul-soo is the only son of a legendary thief family. He falls in love with Young-hee who is a police officer. Her family is also a police family. To get her parents’ permission to marry, Chul-soo undertakes an exam to become a police officer, but both families work to prevent their marriage.

credits.title: Man on High Heels
credits.overview: Ji-wook is a virile detective with a reputation, but deep down in his heart, he always considered himself as a woman and finally decides to get a transsexual operation. However, his plan falls apart as vicious gang members start their revenge on him.

credits.title: Mr. Go
credits.overview: A 15-year-old circus ringmaster Wei-wei is left all alone with gorilla Ling-ling after grandfather passes away. Thanks to her grandfather's love for baseball, Ling-ling was trained to play baseball and has developed remarkable hitting skills.

credits.title: The Tower
credits.overview: Tower Sky, a luxurious building complex, has organised a lavish Christmas party for its VIP guests. However, things go awry when a fire breaks out and thousands of lives are endangered.

credits.title: The Taste of Money
credits.overview: The assistant of a wealthy socialite reveals her husband's salacious affair. The fallout entangles him in a web of sex, love and deceit that could threaten his life and career.

credits.title: As One
credits.overview: A unified team representing the two Koreas competed at the 1991 Chiba International Table Tennis Championships. It was the first such sport team since the division of the Korean peninsula. The unified team won the group competition event, beating the front runner, China.

credits.title: Gabi
credits.overview: Set towards the end of the 19th century, when coffee was first introduced to Korea, Russian sharpshooter Illichi  and Joseon's first barista Danya are manipulated by Japanese officer Sadako into an elaborate plan to assassinate King Gojong.

credits.title: Nameless Gangster
credits.overview: Ik-hyeon, a corrupt officer, joins forces with another crook, Hyung-bae, to continue his illegal activities before he loses his job. Eventually, he decides to escape and pin the blame on his partner.

credits.title: Couples
credits.overview: A kind-hearted man's heartbreak leads to an unexpected romance when his deceitful fiancée abandons him for a dangerous mobster.

credits.title: Unbowed
credits.overview: Inspired by the true story of Kim Kyung-ho, a math professor who was arrested for shooting a crossbow at the presiding judge of his appeal against unfair dismissal.

credits.title: Meet the In-Laws
credits.overview: When cartoonist Hyun-joon falls in love with Da-hong, one of his fans, it sets up the archetypal battle between their two families, who are from rival regions. credits.title: Tooku no Sora
credits.overview: During the 1980 Gwangju uprising in South Korea, a Korean man and a second-generation Korean-Japanese woman meet during the student activist movement. credits.title: Man of Vendetta
credits.overview: A respected pastor is shattered when his daughter is kidnapped and not returned. He renounces his faith in God and becomes a corrupt businessman. Years later, he receives a call and finds that his daughter is still alive and is with the kidnapper. His resolute attempt to rescue her begins.

credits.title: Hello Murderer
credits.overview: Slacker detective Jeong-min (Kim Dong-wuk) is assigned to investigate a serial killer case. For the first time in his career he puts his heart into his work but Yeong-seok (Yoo Oh-seong), an unemployed man with natural instincts as a detective, gets in the way by trying to catch the killer as well.

credits.title: Lady Daddy
credits.overview: A successful photographer's perfect life unravels when her long-hidden past arrives at her doorstep in the form of a son she fathered before transitioning.

credits.title: Private Eye
credits.overview: The story takes place in occupied Korea at the start of the 20th century, where a young student in medicine discovers the murdered body of the son of a government official. credits.title: Ride Away
credits.overview: Ha-jung, a college freshman, is interested in a boy who works at a secondhand book store near her school. Although a clerk is excited by her, he cannot forget his old girlfriend who has been unconscious since a car accident three years earlier. The growing pains mature the awkward and immature twenty-year-old.

credits.title: Dance of the Dragon
credits.overview: The story of three people whose lives are pulled into review and assessment when their paths cross. credits.title: Once Upon a Time
credits.overview: The film is a heist comedy set in 1940s Korea, and stars Park Yong-woo and Lee Bo-young as a con artist and jazz singer who each plot to steal a valuable diamond from the Japanese authorities.

credits.title: Epitaph
credits.overview: A man and his wife investigate a string of murders, a medical student sees visions of a dead girl, and a child is haunted by her dead parent's ghosts.

credits.title: Hwang Jin Yi
credits.overview: Although born a daughter of an aristocratic family, Jin-yi discovers the secret behind her birth and enters into a life in a brothel as a gisaeng.

credits.title: Beautiful Sunday
credits.overview: Detective Kang gets involved with a drug business to pay the medical bill of his comatose wife. Min-woo confesses to Kang that he has killed his wife, who knows his past. Slowly, Kang realizes his wife's incident and Min-woo are connected.

credits.title: Small Town Rivals
credits.overview: Cho Chun-sam and Noh Dae-gyu, now both in their thirties, are old friends who went to the same elementary school. In their school days, Chun-sam was always the ambitious class president, while Dae-gyu had to settle for a role as vice president. Twenty years later their roles are reversed: Chun-sam is now a humble farme

credits.title: The Old Garden
credits.overview: Political activist Hyun-woo is released from prison after a 17-year stint. Journeying back to the village where he spent some time as a fugitive he recalls the time spent with Yoon-hee, a woman who gave him shelter and companionship.

credits.title: Tazza: The High Rollers
credits.overview: Go-ni tries his best to worship Pyung Gyung-jang as his teacher, and promises to stop gambling after winning his money back. But people's desires are endless.

credits.title: Marrying the Mafia 3: Family Hustle
credits.overview: Lead by matriarch widow Hong Duk-ja, the Hong gangster family turns legitimate, but a figure from their past returns to undermine and ruin their popular new business.

credits.title: No Mercy for the Rude
credits.overview: A mute hit-man vows to kill only the rude, and save up enough money for tongue surgery.

credits.title: Bloody Reunion
credits.overview: Mi-ja, who has been taking care of a retired teacher, Ms. Park, invites several of her former students to her house 16 years after their graduation. Since the end of her teaching career, Park has been residing in the countryside, suffering from an illness while an ex-student, the kind and pretty Mi-ja cares for her.

credits.title: Hanbando
credits.overview: The President of South Korea races against time to prove the seal on documents from long dead King Gojong is fake by charging outspoken historian Choi Min-jae, and a descendant of the royal bloodline Kim Yu-shik, to find the long lost seal in order to prove that the Japanese claim to railroads is false, a claim that wi

credits.title: My Boss, My Teacher
credits.overview: A mobster must complete college and spend some time as an ethics teacher in order to receive a promotion to a coveted territory.

credits.title: The Art of Fighting
credits.overview: Byung-tae is the kid who is always on the receiving end of beatings from the school bullies—that is, until he meets Pan-su, a martial arts expert who takes him under his wing.

credits.title: Blue Swallow
credits.overview: At a young age Kyoung-won knows she wants to become a pilot. When she reaches the right age, she travels to Japan to learn how to fly, and becomes Korea's first female pilot.

credits.title: Wedding Campaign
credits.overview: A 38-year-old single man, Hong Man-Taek is a petty farmer still living with his mother. Seeing a neighbor married to an Uzbekistan bride and frightened by the fact that his own grandson will never get married, Man-Taek's grandfather decides to send Man-tek to Uzbekistan to find a bride.

credits.title: Never to Lose
credits.overview: “Never to Lose” concerns the men of Homicide Unit 3, who are in dire straits at the moment. While Unit 3’s cops are full of ambition and talent, they never seem to crack a case. The team is comprised of Detective Koh, a 15 year veteran, Detective Kim (Min-jun Kim), a rookie eager to make a name for himself, Detective K

credits.title: The President's Last Bang
credits.overview: On October 26, 1979, President Park Chung-hee, who had ruled South Korea since 1961, was assassinated by his director of intelligence. The film depicts the events of that night.

credits.title: Lovely Rivals
credits.overview: A teacher and her student compete for the affection of a handsome man.

credits.title: Ghost House
credits.overview: The day that Pil-gi waited for so many years has finally come: hes getting his own house, the last wish of his deceased father. And what a perfect house it is! Big, beautiful, isolated, next to the ocean and at that price, Pil-gi couldn't have found a better place.

credits.title: Romance of Their Own
credits.overview: Han-kyung a rustic girl, comes to town to live with her mom. Attracted to her pure charm, the most popular guys Hae-won and Tae-sung come up to fight each other. But Tae- sung has a fatal secret not to love her. Their sad love triangle makes everyone cry.

credits.title: A Good Lawyer's Wife
credits.overview: A woman, married and with a child but becoming increasingly distant from her husband who is already cheating on her, reluctantly enters a secret relationship with her neighbor, a teenage boy.

credits.title: Singles
credits.overview: Na-nan has known best pals Dong-mi and Jung-joon since childhood, and now the trio shares the ups and downs of their turbulent single lives together. But everything gets turned on end when Dong-mi and Jung-joon end up in bed!

credits.title: My Teacher, Mr. Kim
credits.overview: A teacher attempts to lure his handful of students in a small, rural school to Seoul so that he can move on to a better school. His efforts backfire however, and his school becomes one of the highest ranked in the nation.

credits.title: Jail Breakers
credits.overview: Two inmates break out of a prison only to discover afterwards that they are up for parole. Desperate to get their lives back on track, they realize their best move is to break back into the prison without being noticed.

credits.title: Chihwaseon
credits.overview: Jang Seung-eop, also known as "Chihwaseon," drinks and paints all day. Through Mae-hyang, he learns the meaning of fate, sees art beyond even the smallest things, and sets out for the path he seeks.

credits.title: Fun Movie
credits.overview: Within the past ten years, Korean film industry has taken a huge leap in both quality and volume. There were hugely successful blockbusters as well as other features with vast range of subjects. credits.title: 2009: Lost Memories
credits.overview: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

credits.title: Kick the Moon
credits.overview: Choi Ki-dong, who becomes a teacher, and Park Young-jun, who becomes a gang member, meet again after 10 years. To compete for Min Ju-ran, they start a fierce battle remembering their high school days, when the situation was completely different.

credits.title: Tears
credits.overview: Four teens live their troubled lives as vagabonds in Seoul's Garibongdong District. Chang is rebellious and violent; Han explores the strange world of the Garibong through Chang; Ran dreams of happiness within harsh reality; and Sa-ri harbors painful life experiences.

credits.title: Attack the Gas Station!
credits.overview: A quartet of disaffected Korean youths have robbed a Seoul gas station. credits.title: Girls' Night Out
credits.overview: Three best friends meet and boldly talk about sex together. Their characters are as different as their lifestyles. One works at a hotel, one at a design firm and the other is a graduate student. The conversations alter their lives as they begin to have different sexual relationships than before.

credits.title: Two Cops 3
credits.overview: A pair of tough, unconventional cops take on the underworld.
